articles.summary: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - B2Gold Corp. (TSX: BTO, NYSE AMERICAN: BTG, NSX: B2G) (B2Gold or the Company) is pleased to announce its operational and financial results for the third quarter of 2026. All dollar figures are in United States dollars unless otherwise indicated. The consolidated financial statements and Management Discussion and Analysis (MDA) relating to these results are available at www​.b2gold.com. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Revenue of $836 million on 195,018 gold ounces sold at an average realized price of $4,289 per ounce. Production of 193,321 ounces of gold, on track to deliver full-year production guidance at all operations. Cash flow provided by operating activities of $239 million , cash flow from operating activities before changes in working capital 1 of $387 million, and free cash flow 2 of $48 million, reflecting the first quarter post completion of the prepaid gold sales
articles.title: B2Gold Reports Q3 2026 Results - Lowers Annual All-In Sustaining Cost Guidance and Remains On-Track to Achieve Production Guidance
